diameterInterpretation: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations. The selected archive gives 126 ± 3 km equivalent-volume size; its size error is not local shape accuracy. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Selected archive equivalent-diameter error; not a local shape-accuracy bound or automatically a one-sigma confidence interval.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Selected DAMIT archived solution volume-equivalent diameter, independently checked against raw mesh volume.
calibration.limitations: Hanuš 2017 confirms the pole family using disk-resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations. Section on 129 describes eight AO images while TableA.1 lists nine; this discrepancy is retained. Archive D126±3 km is retained; local shape accuracy is not the diameter uncertainty.
